title: Mahjong Meld Pop
description: Pick glossy 3D mahjong tiles from stacked boards and snap matching triplets together in fast-paced chain combos before your tray fills up.
controls: Tap available 3D mahjong tiles to send them to your tray; match three identical tiles to pop them and use booster tools when stuck.

zh-CN.title: 麻将吃碰消不停
zh-CN.description: 清脆带感的 3D 麻将三消连碰：从立体牌堆中眼疾手快挑出三张同花色麻将，一碰即爆爽快清场。
zh-CN.controls: 点击可拾取的 3D 麻将牌放入下方槽位，凑齐三张相同牌自动碰消，支持撤回与洗牌道具。
